item.title: Audiotonix Expands with DPA, Wisycom & Austrian Audio Acquisition
item.description: Audiotonix has announced an agreement to acquire three pioneering microphone and wireless audio companies: DPA Microphones, Wisycom, and Austrian Audio.

item.title: Sony Beefs Up AF and More in V5.00 Firmware for the A7s III
item.description: V5.00 firmware for the Sony A7s III adds a whole range of new features including AF improvements, accommodations for vertical shooting, USB streaming, and more.

item.title: Vinten Unveils VEGA Lite: Broadcast-Ready PTZ Control With AI Tracking
item.description: Robotic camera specialist Vinten has launched VEGA Lite, a broadcast-ready PTZ control system for studios working with PTZ cameras.

item.title: Canon RF 7–14mm F2.8–3.5 L Fisheye STM Announced: 190° Zoom for Sports and VR
item.description: One of two new RF-mount lenses expected to be available from Canon by the end of February 2026, the RF 7-14mm F2.8-3.5 L Fisheye STM zoom lens offers a wild 190° field of view.

item.title: Canon RF 14mm F1.4 L VCM Announced: Fast Ultra-Wide Prime for Stills and Video
item.description: The brightest ultra-wide-angle interchangeable lens it's ever produced, Canon's new RF 14mm F1.4 L VCM Prime Lens provides ultra-wide angle views with a fast f/1.4 aperture.

item.title: Aputure Firmware Update: Big Enhancements for NOVA II 2x1 and STORM XT52, Plus Range-Wide Fixes
item.description: Aputure has released new firmware for all fixtures in its STORM, NOVA II, and NOVA 9° families, with improvements including enhanced fan control, NFC and Bluetooth stability, HSIC+ adjustment, and DMX enhancements.

item.title: Blackmagic PYXIS 12K Recall: Free Sensor Board Upgrade for Early Units
item.description: Blackmagic Design has announced a recall of all early PYXIS 12K cameras manufactured before serial number 14221337. The company is offering a free sensor board upgrade for affected units or a replacement camera.

item.title: How the 2026 Winter Olympics Will Be Broadcast: 800+ Cameras and FPV Drones
item.description: The Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics start today, and Olympic Broadcast Services is deploying a serious amount of cutting edge technology to cover it.

item.title: Why We Chose It: Dream Sequences and Challenges with the Blackmagic PYXIS 12K
item.description: "Beautiful colour and large format, all in a tiny body." Why Cinematographer James Westlake used the Blackmagic PYXIS 12K on independent feature Imagination of a Phoenix.

item.title: Super Bowl LX: The Camera Tech Behind the Broadcast
item.description: Super Bowl LX takes place on Sunday February 8 at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, and the sheer amount of camera tech being deployed to capture the event is astonishing.
